# askdare

> `@boldare/askdare` adds an AI chatbot to any website. A Next.js 16 app (App Router, Node.js runtime) serves the chat from one catch-all route; other sites embed it with one `<script>` tag. Built on the official `openai` SDK (Responses and Conversations APIs); no database required, or conversations and knowledge in your own Postgres.

Set it up with `npx @boldare/askdare init` and verify it with `npx @boldare/askdare doctor`. The public API is `defineBot` (which returns a `BotHandle`), `defineTool`, `defineForm`, `defineTheme`, `turnstile` and `ERROR_CODES` from `@boldare/askdare`; `memoryConversations`, `memoryTurnLog`, `memoryAdminStore` and `openaiEmbedder` from `@boldare/askdare`; `createChatHandler` (with `onError`, `onUsage`, `onFeedback`, `onTranscript`, `onHandoff`, `onLead`, `conversations`, `resume` and `admin`, returning `GET`, `POST`, `DELETE` and `sweep`), `webhookHandoff`, `emailHandoff` and `getChatConfig` from `@boldare/askdare/next`; `Root`, `DefaultChat`, the hooks and the primitives (including `Disclosure`, `HumanCheck` and `LoadEarlier`) from `@boldare/askdare/react`; the CLI commands (`init`, `doctor`, `kb sync` with `--index`, `add ui`); `postgresConversations`, `postgresAdminStore`, `pgvectorIndex` and the `askdare-postgres migrate` command from `@boldare/askdare-postgres`; `upstashStore`, `upstashTurnLog` and `upstashAdminStore` from `@boldare/askdare-upstash`; `adminDashboard` from `@boldare/askdare-admin` and `otelUsage` from `@boldare/askdare-otel`; the `data-*` attributes of the script tag, `askdare(…)` on the page, the `--ask-*` CSS tokens, the `data-ask-part` names and the text keys. Everything else is internal.

## Docs

- [Getting started](docs/getting-started.md): install, `init`, `.env.local`, `doctor`, embedding on other sites
- [Configuration](docs/configuration.md): every `defineBot` and `createChatHandler` option, limits with defaults, the human check (`security.humanVerifier: turnstile({ siteKey })`, `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`), `limits.requireSharedStore`, `limits.compactAt` (compaction), `conversations`, `resume`, `onTranscript`, environment variables
- [Embedding](docs/embedding.md): the script tag and its `data-*` attributes, several bots, the host page's CSP, your own page in the widget's iframe (`embedPath`, `EmbedRoot`, `embedPageHeaders`), staging and production, the launcher's greeting (`widget.launcherGreeting`, `data-greeting="off"`) and unread badge
- [CLI](docs/cli.md): `init`, `doctor` (including model shutdown dates, bots with the AI notice off, and your own store and index), `kb sync` (to a vector store or, with `--index`, your own index), `add ui` and `usage`, with every flag
- [Troubleshooting](docs/troubleshooting.md): symptoms, causes and fixes, by error code (`ERROR_CODES`)
- [Tools](docs/tools.md): `defineTool`, Zod schemas, what a tool may trust, and `ui`: what the visitor sees of a result as a card
- [Forms and leads](docs/forms.md): `defineForm` and its six field types, `forms` in `defineBot`, the `show_form` tool, `onLead` (required for forms the model may show) and its report, `toModel`, consent, limits; askdare stores no values
- [Handoff to a person](docs/handoff.md): `handoff` in `defineBot` (`model`, `button`, `form`, `available`, `content`, `limits`), the "Talk to a person" button and the `handoff` tool, `onHandoff` (awaited, 10 seconds) with `webhookHandoff` (Standard Webhooks) or `emailHandoff`, the six states, what the report carries
- [Reply options](docs/reply-options.md): clickable answers under the latest reply, suggested by the model (`widget.replies: 'suggest'`) or defined by a tool (`defineTool({ replies })`), limits, placement, cost
- [Signed-in visitors](docs/identity.md): `askdare('identify')`, IDENTITY_SECRET, `context.identity`
- [Knowledge base](docs/knowledge-base.md): `npx @boldare/askdare kb sync`, vector stores or your own index in Postgres (`--index`), citations
- [Attachments](docs/attachments.md): images and PDFs from visitors
- [Voice input](docs/voice-input.md): dictation and its limits
- [Styling](docs/styling.md): texts, languages, AI disclosure, custom CSS and the `data-ask-part` names, `askdare('open' | 'configure')`, inline mode
- [React](docs/react.md): the chat inside a page of your own app with `@boldare/askdare/react`: `getChatConfig`, `Root`, `DefaultChat`, hooks and primitives, older messages in pages (`LoadEarlier`, `loadEarlier()`), tool cards (`toolRenderers`, `ToolResults`, `Link`), the AI notice in your own markup (`Disclosure`), the human check (`HumanCheck`), CSS resets, CSP, `add ui`
- [Texts](docs/texts.md): every text key with its default in each built-in language (en, cs, de, es, fr, it, pl), plurals, adding a language, switching the chat's language on the page (`askdare('configure', { locale })`, `data-follow-lang`)
- [Themes](docs/themes.md): Halo, Aura, Sage and Care, tokens and variants
- [Deployment](docs/deployment.md): Vercel, Heroku, proxies, shared limits, resuming answers
- [Own your data](docs/own-your-data.md): moving a bot to your own Postgres: `postgresConversations`, `pgvectorIndex` with `kb sync --index`, `migrate`, `doctor`, resume with `upstashTurnLog`, `limits.compactAt`, `onTranscript`, sweeping old conversations, what stays at OpenAI (ZDR, data residency), costs
- [Going public](docs/going-public.md): OpenAI project, secrets, limits, privacy checklist
- [Guardrails](docs/guardrails.md): opt-in OpenAI moderation (`moderation`), your own `onInput` and `onOutput` rules to allow, block or redact, answers held back while they are checked, `toolResults: 'untrusted'`
- [Costs](docs/costs.md): the worst case under the default limits, how to keep it bounded, long conversations and compaction
- [Observability](docs/observability.md): `onUsage` and `onError`, cost per turn, OpenTelemetry spans with `@boldare/askdare-otel`
- [Chat events](docs/events.md): what the chat reports to the page, for analytics
- [Admin console and dashboard](docs/admin.md): `admin` in `createChatHandler` (`store`, `transcripts`, `retentionDays`, `console` with `allow` and `dashboard`), `ADMIN_SECRET` or an identity token with audience `askdare:admin`, `postgresAdminStore`, `upstashAdminStore`, `adminDashboard({ prices })`, `sweep()`, what the admin store keeps
- [Answer ratings](docs/feedback.md): 👍/👎 with an optional comment, `onFeedback`, what the report holds
- [Privacy](docs/privacy.md): what is stored where and sent to whom (OpenAI, its moderation endpoint, Cloudflare for the human check, your own conversation store, the turn log, transcripts, handoffs and leads, the admin store), for your privacy policy
- [Compliance](docs/compliance.md): AI Act disclosure (`widget.disclosure`, the `Disclosure` primitive), GDPR (DPA, retention, deletion), data residency, the resume token in inline mode, hosts other than Vercel and Heroku, no Edge runtime
- [Accessibility](docs/accessibility.md): the WCAG 2.2 AA conformance statement: scope, how it is tested, finished answers announced to screen readers, focus kept in a full-screen chat, known limitations
- [Support](docs/support.md): Node.js (22, 24 and 26), Next.js, React, zod and TypeScript versions, browsers, sizes
- [Migrating from @boldare/openai-assistant](docs/migrating-from-openai-assistant.md): what maps to what

## Optional

- [Streaming protocol](docs/protocol.md): the SSE events between the server and the chat, endpoints, history pages (`before`), resuming an answer (`POST /resume`) and status codes
- [Custom stores](docs/custom-store.md): writing your own store for limits and budgets, for conversations (`ConversationStore`), or a turn event log (`TurnEventLog`), with the contract suites from `@boldare/askdare/testing`
